Close Encounter of the 69th kind

Hey, dude. Long time no see! Btw... are you drawing a blank too? Last night at the singles bar, I lasered in on this galacitcally hawt babe. Green alabaster skin and antennae on her forehead included. And then... Oh my God! A red flash of light... Flying saucers... and... HELP MEEEEE! THE PROBE!!! Ahem. Let’s talk after work, okay? I need to process this…

I don't believe it, dude! I was abducted by aliens! Fiona just told me that I went missing for years. Apparently, Lin took over my job, in addition to the juice-pushing, in order to save my behind. I'll buy her a big bouquet of flowers after I get a a date with our new airport therapist lined up. No starlight lillies, though.
Send {number} plane(s)
Con Air

Hey, thingummy! He's back, you know? Come on, you know who I'm talking about. Tariq... the... uuuuhh... pirate. No, wait. Pilot. A few years ago, he disappeared without a trace after a binge drinking session with my hubby, Kurt. Now he claims that visitors from space have cutenapped... no... wait ... kidnapped him. Or something like that. Anyway, our airport has now become a pilgrimage site for tin foil hat wearers. Take care of 'em.

Well, that was easier than expected. I had... accidentally... moved the venues of the science fiction convention to the cargo hold of an aeroplane. Now they're all on their way to... somewhere. Or nowhere. Anywhere's good, as long as it's not here.
Return {number} plane(s)
Space Bucks

Hi! Do you remember how I swept Fiona off her feet? Those were the days, eh? Come on, I'll turn back the clock and wrap her around my little finger just like I used to. I might even go and buy her a star!
You should’ve seen Fi-Fi's eyes light up when I slapped that star right under her nose, huh? For my sweetheart, no distance is too far… not even to the souvenir store.
Collect {number} AirCoin(s)
Ramageddon

Hey, thingummy! I'm totally panicking... well, what's the word I'm looking for? Terror, that's it! The radar is showing a huge meteorite on a collision course with the airport! If that thing crashes into us, it will smash our premises like a load of building blocks. Code red! CODE RED! Evacuate as many people as you can!

Wow! How embarrassing... The meteorite on the radar was actually just a... er... how do you say it in English? A roastbeef smudge. Embarrassing, huh? From now on, I'll only eat beetroot soup at work, I can promise you that much.
Collect {number} passenger(s)
Sad-Man!

Hey, dude! Those EU hotties are totally into superheroes, says Kurt. And you know what? I’ve always wanted to slip into one of those skin-tight spandex suits and show off my well-sculpted pilot bod. Come on, let's fly to Europe and show the babes what a real hero is like. Curtains up for the ‘Propellator’...

Well, that's just... At first I thought the girls were whistling at me... But then you trip over your cape a few times and suddenly you hear them whistling you off! They call me the ‘Propelator’ now. Well, who cares? At least I don't have to squeeze a girdle under my super suit anymore.
Send {number} planes to Europe
2024: A Tariq Odyssey

Hey buddy! The babes at NASA are perfect rocket fuel for a space explorer of my calibre. High ponytails, stylish glasses, and always armed with a sensual clipboard. What more could you want? Come on, let's jet off to the US and show these gals how irresistible Uncle Tariq is in zero gravity. Hehehehe...
Holy smokes! That shuttle ride shook me to my core! And they didn’t even have flight attendants. What kind of operation is this? So much for Cape Carnival…
Send {number} planes to North America
Mars Attacks!

I’ve had it up to here! Earth girls are so demanding. “Take out the trash!” “Put the toilet seat UP!” “Put the toilet seat DOWN!” “Don’t cheat on me!” Enough with the drama! South America’s got tons of UFO sightings. Let’s jet over there right now—maybe I’ll find that hot tentacle babe who invited me into her spaceship a while back.

Oh God... what happened? I was at a Brazilian bar, sweet-talking this cute Chiquita, and then... blackout. Six days later, I wake up in the gutter—with a long beard, boozy breath, and no spare change. It had to be ALIENS! I GOT ABDUCTED AGAIN! There’s no other explanation…

Got a headache pill?
Send {number} planes to South America
